doc:
Finite Weave dash: conserved-charge ledger (energy E, momentum P, boost/centre-of-energy charge K = E X - c^2 P t).
NON-CANON physics exercise (SOL handoff e17fd62). ALL bodies. ALL sponsors. 2026-2226.

Premise (from Weave foundations §16): M2 is a parent action S[W,Phi] = S_R[W] + S_matter[Phi,W], delta S/delta W = J_Phi.
If that action is local and diffeomorphism-invariant and the exterior is asymptotically flat, then within a fixed global sector
Lambda (Metric, foundations §15) the Poincare charges (E, P, J, K) of ship + source + Weave field + environment are conserved,
changing only by flux through the boundary at infinity. This is a theorem of such theories (Noether + Bianchi), not a lane rule.
A Loom transition (Lambda_A -> Lambda_B) is outside this premise by construction (M1).

ship.note: ship starts and ends at rest; centre of energy moved by dX

ledger.verdict_isolated: INCONSISTENT: an isolated start-dash-stop that leaves the ship displaced and the field relaxed with nothing else changed violates K conservation. SOL's note is right that no NET impulse is needed; it is incomplete because K is also conserved.

R1 radiation to infinity.basis: each impulse p radiated costs >= p c (start and stop): >= 2 m v c
R1 radiation to infinity.verdict: DERIVED bound; prohibitive (~3.7 PJ for this dash)

R2 exterior Weave field reaching environ.verdict: DERIVED structure; requires S_R to have exterior range (a compact, exterior-flat domain has no local channel)

R3 nonlocal exchange to a distant partne.basis: work in partner frame = dp . v_rel, v_rel ~ 29.8 km/s
R3 nonlocal exchange to a distant partne.verdict: needs M1 nonlocality; partner law UNDETERMINED; Sun partner near a planet harvests relative motion (see cycle)

R4 persistent field remnant (energy-dipo.comparison: SOL wall scale ~1.9e32 J x R ~ 1.9e33 J m: a ~6e-10 asymmetry
R4 persistent field remnant (energy-dipo.verdict: mathematically allowed in an exotic sector; requires a permanent +/- energy separation of order m c^2 dX: physically extreme, M2 constitutive law UNDETERMINED

R5 Loom transition (change Lambda).verdict: outside Metric by construction (M1). A displacement that discharges K without flux is a Loom-type event, i.e. option 2 / Weave seams (foundations §19)

velocity.statement: With a partner channel the final ship velocity is u_f = u_i + dP/m: velocity CAN change. Crew stay inertial (interior geodesic, SOL).

energy_in_partner_frame.case: Wayfarer 1168 t to 0.268c (canon NORMAL), local partner

velocity.canon_tension: Canon reaches 0.268c from a ~2 GJ bank. Under R2/R3 with immediate discharge that costs ~1/2 m v^2 ~ 4e21 J. Canon metric is therefore consistent with the charge theorem only via R4 or R5 (exotic remnant or M1 discharge), or by a partner law that is not yet written.
velocity.torch_monopoly: NOT derived: W3 ("torch owns velocity") was a lane rule. Under R2/R3 the Weave can change velocity at energy cost in the partner frame.

closed_cycle.test: metric up-hop 1 km with no source input, ordinary fall, trim (61 t)
closed_cycle.conservation_says: with no source input the hop must conserve the ship's mechanical energy IN THE PARTNER FRAME: v_a^2 = v_s^2 + 2 dPhi there

partner_earth.hover_up_hop: forbidden without source input; with input pays m g h = 0.60 GJ; cycle net 0

partner_sun.meaning: energy-conserving harvest of Earth-Sun relative motion (not perpetual motion), unbounded in practice

closed_cycle.verdict: DERIVED: canon ENERGY-B counted in the Sun frame is equivalent to a Sun partner; near a planet it harvests orbital relative motion. A partner at rest in the local potential frame gives no closed-cycle gain.
